But the day of the Devil Gundam's revival draws near!! And I've found a fine sample, too!!

notes.note: #0.210-219 finish the 14-slot leader block begun at #0.206 (story_087). Slot 12 (#0.217, rough 'nan da to o') = Momotaros, matching story_087 #0.199; #0.218 identical to #0.206 so kept identical.
Master Gundam continues #0.204-205. Glossary term 'Life Core' used for the Devil Gundam host term; story_087 #0.204 used 'biological unit' for the same term and should be aligned to the glossary.
Unlabelled; read as the leader/party rejecting Master Gundam's terms.
Master Gundam's terse 'it won't go that way' kept deliberately open ('That will not do.'); Ankh's reply #0.224 suggests MG is denying the heroes the promised rule of the Cube.
#0.230-237: 4 variant pairs (silence + line), only #0.230-231 labelled ?party. Speaker addresses Master Gundam.

#0.248-275: 14 cry+line pairs, one per possible leader. Cries rendered by their sound (uaa = Agh, u = Ugh, uoo = Uoooh, ku = Ngh, guo = Gwoh, gua = Gaah). Slot 12 (#0.270-271) is Momotaros (rough wording), consistent with the earlier blocks. Subject 'you' restored in 'You planned this'.
Unlabelled; precedes a fight/retreat choice and #0.282 is Ankh, so #0.276 and #0.279 read as Ankh speaking to the leader.
Master Gundam (unlabelled) on a return visit after retreating; #0.287 repeats #0.246, #0.290 is his line if the player declines again.
'Fine sample' = a strong candidate for the Devil Gundam's Life Core (ties to #0.204-205).
#0.300-311 start a 14-slot leader block that runs into story_089 (#0.312-313); all identical.

report: All 80 rows translated. Uncertain: #0.222 speaker inferred (party); #0.223 'That will not do.' kept vague like the source; #0.276/#0.279 inferred as Ankh. Glossary 'Life Core' used at #0.220; story_087 #0.204 still says 'biological unit' and needs aligning. No new names.
